review.assessment: This change introduces a new entitlement layer that uniformly gates access, billing, and routing logic on `account.status in model.ENTITLED_STATUSES` without ever evaluating trial expiration dates against the supplied `as_of` parameter. As a result, accounts with past-due trials (ac-104, ac-106) will remain incorrectly treated as entitled across all four consumers until their status is manually updated by an external process.

findings.actual: Returns `PREMIUM_FEATURES` and counts billable seats because the code only checks if `account.status == 'trial'`, completely ignoring `as_of` and `trial_ends_on`
findings.call: Pass an account object with `status="trial"`, `trial_ends_on="2024-02-15"` to any consumer function with `as_of="2024-03-01"`
findings.defect: Trial expiry logic is entirely absent from all new consumers.
findings.expected: Accounts whose trial has expired must be treated exactly like cancelled accounts (unentitled), returning `BASIC_FEATURES`, zero billable seats, standard support queue placement, and exclusion from recipient lists.
